item.title: RK3568 Platform: Display Subsystem Bring-up and Multi-Interface Debugging
item.description:
• Author: Potter White
  • Date: August 2025

Project Overview

Situation: In a custom project based on the Rockchip RK3568 SoC, the objective was to enable the LVDS, MIPI-DSI, and HDMI 2.0 display interfaces, either simultaneously or independently. The LVDS interface was required to output a 1920x1080@30Hz video stream to an FPGA, exceeding the SoC’s official datasheet specifications (max 1280x800). The HDMI and MIPI interfaces needed to bypass EDID detection and force a fixed 1080p@60Hz output. These data paths were unconfigured in the initial BSP, requiring a complete bring-up from scratch.

item.title: RK3568 Platform Gigabit Ethernet Controller Bring-up and Verification
item.description:
• Author: Potter White
  • Date: July 2025

Project Overview

Situation: In a custom product development project based on the Rockchip RK3568 SoC, I was responsible for the initial functional Bring-up of the onboard Gigabit Ethernet interface (GMAC1, ethernet@fe010000). Under the initial BSP configuration, the network interface failed to be correctly initialized by the kernel, with logs indicating errors such as Cannot attach to PHY and Failed to reset the dma.
